title: Resolution certificate for algebraic self-Tor restriction
statement: For commutative rings A,B, ideals I,J, a ring homomorphism φ:A→B and n≥0, an underlying function q:Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I)→Tor_n^B(B/J,B/J) [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] is certified when for every pair of augmented projective quotient resolutions P,Q there exist a quotient ring map ψ commuting with φ, an A-linear augmented chain comparison a:P→Q restricted along φ, and a tensor chain comparison k taking x⊗y to a(x)⊗ψ(y). For every pair of cycles z,w with iCycles(w)=k(iCycles(z)), the Tor-to-resolution-homology isomorphisms identify q applied to the class of z with the class of w. This specifies the whole map, not just conormal wedge classes.
